task_description: Build Resume Roaster - a web app that gives blunt, constructive feedback on resumes. User uploads or pastes resume, app roasts it with specific feedback following Roast/Why/Fix pattern. Stack: vanilla JS frontend + Node.js backend (built-in modules only due to network constraints) + Anthropic Claude API.

verification.summary: All 29 tests pass. All syntax checks pass. Server starts and serves static files. API endpoints return correct responses for health check, validation errors, and missing API key. Frontend JS has no syntax errors.
